name: Sponsorship for Employment
benefit: Under this scheme, employment opportunities are provided to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts through outsourcing.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman (Army, Navy, or Air Force), their legal dependent, or a widow of an ex-serviceman (Veer Nari).
